name: street-circle
description: A secure neighborhood sharing platform for community-based item and skill exchange with geospatial discovery and conflict-safe requests.

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace streetcircle-frontend && npm run lint --workspace streetcircle-backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace streetcircle-frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace streetcircle-backend
scripts.test: npm test --workspace streetcircle-frontend && npm test --workspace streetcircle-backend
scripts.test:integration:atlas: npm run test:auth:atlas && npm run test:communities:atlas && npm run test:listings:atlas && npm run test:requests:atlas && npm run test:notifications:atlas
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:offline && npm run test:integration:atlas
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace streetcircle-frontend && npm run build --workspace streetcircle-backend
scripts.verify:offline: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration:offline && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
